title: 第21章 战斗偷袭第22章 兽核
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可浑身猛地一颤，那滚烫无比的气息如汹涌的热浪，直直地凶猛地扑向她那娇嫩的面庞。她瞬间反应过来，以迅雷不及掩耳之势施展出[轻身术]，身形如闪电般迅速与那恐怖的蜥蜴拉开了一段距离。
她的心脏剧烈跳动，满心警惕，双眼紧紧地盯着蜥蜴那不断在嘴里伸缩进出的舌头，仿佛那是一条致命的毒蛇。
“又一只愚蠢的野兽来打扰我睡觉。”火焰蜥蜴冷哼一声，那声音中充满了愤怒与不屑。
它张开血盆大口，在嘴里疯狂地聚集起熊熊燃烧的火焰，随后猛地朝着艾可喷射过去。那瞬间，艾可全身的毛根根竖立，好似钢针一般。她的直觉在脑海中疯狂地尖叫着，仿佛死亡的阴影已经笼罩而来，带来无尽的恐惧和绝望。这只蜥蜴对她的恨意如同燃烧的烈火，一心只想将她置于死地。在这种生死关头，根本没有任何谈判的余地，只有拼死一战，才有一线生机。
艾可凭借着[快速跳跃]技能，身形如鬼魅般一闪，勉强避开了那炽热得仿佛能将一切都化为灰烬的火球。紧接着，她巧妙地运用[轻身术]配合冲刺，试图弥补她与蜥蜴之间那巨大的等级差距。
艾可的动作极其灵活，身形如风中的柳絮，飘忽不定，能够险之又险地躲开蜥蜴那狂风暴雨般的所有攻击。然而，她却像是被一道无形的屏障阻挡着，无法靠近蜥蜴分毫，更无法对这强大的敌人造成哪怕一丝一毫的伤害。
这一次，当火球再次带着毁灭一切的气势逼近时，艾可毫不犹豫地施展出[挖掘]技能，瞬间整个人就像是落入水中的石子，一下子钻进了地下。
一直在旁密切关注着局势，随时准备出手营救并斥责艾可的女王，看到这突如其来的一幕，整个人都呆住了，眼神中充满了难以置信和深深的无语。“所以她吞了那碎片还是有点收获的！但这算什么破技能！”她满脸不屑，愤愤地哼了一声。为了那碎片，她失去了能够帮她打造完美洞穴的绝佳机会，可结果换来的却是这样一个让人摸不着头脑的技能……*无奈地叹气*
蜥蜴满心欢喜，得意洋洋地以为已经将那只愚蠢的狐狸烧成了灰烬。它……其实并非是最为聪明睿智的蜥蜴。这也是因为它刚刚艰难地迈入[魔兽等级]，虽然拥有了一定的智力，可这智力反而蒙蔽了它原本敏锐的感官。在进化成为火焰蜥蜴之后，它骄傲自负得不可一世，满心幻想着如果一切顺利，自己还能够进化成为更为强大的[火蝾螈]。从此，它不再依赖敏锐的感官去感知世界，而是单纯地依靠那无与伦比、威力强大的火焰。而那些火焰还因为[火焰碎片]的神秘能量得到了进一步的强化，使得它能够更为迅速地准备好强大的技能，而且释放出的技能威力也变得更为强大恐怖。毕竟，它正是众多修炼者命丧此地的首要罪魁祸首。那些修炼者们无一不渴望得到这珍贵的碎片，因为它能够极大地提升他们的[火属性修炼]，有的甚至能够借此改善自身的[灵根]，从而踏上更高的修炼境界！
艾可在蜥蜴的下方悄无声息地移动着，小心翼翼地从下面探出了脑袋。蜥蜴丝毫没有察觉到她的存在，这一侧完全没有任何防备。艾可的目光落在了那片粉粉的、看上去十分柔软的皮肤上。那皮肤看起来似乎鲜嫩多汁，很好吃的样子。
她毫不犹豫地使用[抓挠]技能，朝着那片皮肤狠狠地抓去，然而，造成的伤口却浅得可怜。甚至连一滴鲜血都没有流淌出来！
她旋即又像受惊的兔子一般，迅速钻回了地下。蜥蜴满心困惑，完全不明白为什么自己的后腿会突然感到一阵痒痒。
女王看到这一幕，差点忍不住用手捂住自己的脸。她原本是想通过这场战斗，给艾可设置一定的难度，让她在生死边缘挣扎中获得成长和突破，可万万没想到与她同级别的家伙居然如此愚笨，如此不堪一击。“这……看着真是让人难受。”她紧皱着眉头，脸上写满了失望和无奈。“都怪那莫名其妙的土系技能！要是她没有这鸡肋的技能，至少还能拼死挣扎一番！”女王并不知道艾可根本没有任何远程攻击的技能。大多数暗影兽都具备某种独特的远程技能，可以巧妙地借助敌人的影子发起出其不意的攻击。这也是暗影兽在影子众多的地面上如此强大、令人畏惧的重要缘由所在。
艾可心急如焚地打开菜单，仔细查看并果断升级了[抓挠]技能。瞬间，它变成了更为强大的[撕裂]技能，能够造成高额惊人的伤害，但同时也要消耗大量的体力和珍贵的兽核能量。
艾可悄悄地移动到蜥蜴的身后，再次小心翼翼地探出头来。此时，她的体力状况还算不错，可由于身处地下，她根本看不见蜥蜴的确切位置，这让她感到十分棘手。
蜥蜴此时已经懒洋洋地躺了下来，似乎对这场战斗感到十分无聊，完全提不起兴趣。而这个时机对于艾可来说，正好可以趁机攻击它的弱点……但究竟该攻击何处呢？！
“我使用[弱点侦测]的时候，它全身都是红色的。”艾可皱起了眉头，脸上满是苦恼和困惑。看来她得更加用心地关注技能的等级提升了，否则在这场实力悬殊的战斗中，她根本没有丝毫胜算。
她下定决心，钻到地下，朝着蜥蜴的尾巴坚定地前进。她全神贯注，精神高度集中，在蜥蜴最为放松、毫无防备的时刻，果断施展出了[撕裂]技能。
*撕裂声*
“啊啊啊啊啊”蜥蜴发出了凄厉无比、撕心裂肺的尖叫声，声音在这片空旷的沙漠中回荡，仿佛要冲破云霄。因为有人竟然深深地割伤了它尾巴的下方，那钻心的疼痛让它几乎要发狂。

艾可看到所造成的严重伤害以及四处喷溅的鲜血，眼睛顿时亮了起来，兴奋得咯咯直笑，笑声中充满了惊喜和激动。她万万没有想到如此简单的一次技能升级，竟然能产生如此显着惊人的效果……但与此同时，这次攻击也确实消耗了她大量的体力。她心里清楚，必须要更加谨慎妥善地管理体力储备，否则稍有不慎，很可能就会丢掉自己的小命。
她躲在地下，大气都不敢出，因为蜥蜴在她上方像是发了疯一般不停地闹腾。
她静静地等待着，不敢有丝毫的轻举妄动，因为她清楚地知道，倘若她能够保持不动，[挖掘]技能所消耗的体力将会大大减少。
“你这混蛋到底在哪儿？！给我滚出来！”蜥蜴扯着嗓子，声嘶力竭地大声吼叫，声音中充满了愤怒和疯狂。可任凭它如何吼叫，如何寻找，就是找不到那个神秘的攻击者，这让它愈发愤怒，内心的兽性彻底被激发了出来，陷入了癫狂的状态。
随后，它突然留意到下方有个小小的东西，在地下深处若隐若现。
*吼*
它毫不犹豫，立刻将自身的体温提升到了极致，周围的温度瞬间急剧升高，仿佛置身于火炉之中。附近的沙子和石头在这恐怖的高温下，都瞬间转化成了晶莹剔透的玻璃。这股炽热的力量深深地穿透到地下，仿佛要将一切隐藏在地下的生物都烧成灰烬。
艾可感受到这股几乎能将灵魂都灼烧的炽热热量，顿时被吓得魂飞魄散，肝胆俱裂。她没有丝毫的犹豫，立刻朝着更深处、更远离蜥蜴的方向拼命逃窜，用尽全身的力气去躲避这股几乎能毁灭一切的热浪冲击。
content_en:
Aike's whole body trembled violently, and the extremely hot breath was like a raging heat wave, rushing straight and fiercely towards her delicate face. She reacted instantly and performed the [Light Body Technique] with lightning speed, and quickly distanced herself from the terrifying lizard as fast as lightning.
Her heart was beating violently, and she was full of vigilance. Her eyes were fixed on the lizard's tongue that was constantly stretching in and out of its mouth, as if it were a deadly poisonous snake.
"Another stupid beast came to disturb my sleep." The flame lizard snorted, the voice full of anger and disdain.
It opened its bloody mouth, crazily gathering blazing flames in its mouth, and then violently sprayed it towards Echo. At that moment, all the hairs on Aike's body stood up like steel needles. Her instincts screamed crazily in her mind, as if the shadow of death had loomed over her, bringing endless fear and despair. The lizard's hatred for her was like a burning fire, and it wanted nothing more than to put her to death. At this critical moment of life and death, there is no room for negotiation at all. Only by fighting to the death can there be a glimmer of hope.
Ai Ke relied on the [Quick Jump] skill to dodge like a ghost, barely avoiding the fireball that was so hot that it seemed like it could turn everything into ashes. Immediately afterwards, she cleverly used [Light Body Technique] in conjunction with sprinting, trying to make up for the huge level gap between her and the lizard.
Ai Ke's movements are extremely flexible, his body shape is like catkins in the wind, erratic, and he can dodge all the lizard's violent attacks with great difficulty. However, she seemed to be blocked by an invisible barrier, unable to get even close to the lizard, let alone cause even the slightest harm to this powerful enemy.
This time, when the fireball once again approached with the aura of destroying everything, Aike did not hesitate to use the [dig] skill, and in an instant, his whole body was like a stone falling into the water, and suddenly got into the ground.
The Queen, who had been paying close attention to the situation and was ready to rescue and scold Aike at any time, was stunned when she saw this sudden scene, her eyes filled with disbelief and deep speechlessness. "So she gained something by swallowing the fragment! But what a useless skill!" She looked disdainful and snorted angrily. For that fragment, she lost the perfect opportunity to help her build a perfect cave, but what she got in exchange was such a puzzling skill... *sighs helplessly*
The lizard was filled with joy and triumphantly thought that he had burned the stupid fox to ashes. It... is actually not the most intelligent and wise lizard. This is also because it has just entered the [Warcraft Level] with difficulty. Although it has a certain amount of intelligence, this intelligence has blinded its originally sharp senses. After evolving into a flame lizard, it was extremely arrogant and arrogant, dreaming that if everything went well, it could evolve into a more powerful [fire salamander]. From then on, it no longer relied on its keen senses to perceive the world, but simply relied on the incomparable and powerful flame. And those flames have been further strengthened by the mysterious energy of [Fire Fragments], allowing it to prepare powerful skills more quickly, and the power of the skills released has become more powerful and terrifying. After all, it is the primary culprit responsible for the deaths of many cultivators here. Those cultivators are all eager to obtain this precious fragment, because it can greatly improve their [Fire Attribute Cultivation], and some can even use it to improve their own [Spiritual Roots], thereby embarking on a higher cultivation realm!
Echo moved quietly underneath the lizard and carefully poked his head out from underneath. The lizard was not aware of her presence at all, and was completely defenseless on this side. Aike's eyes fell on the pink, soft-looking skin. That skin looksIt looks tender, juicy and delicious.
She used the [Scratch] skill without hesitation and scratched hard at that piece of skin. However, the wounds caused were pitifully shallow. Not even a drop of blood was shed!
She immediately burrowed back into the ground like a frightened rabbit. The lizard was confused and didn't understand why his hind legs suddenly felt itchy.
When the queen saw this scene, she almost couldn't help covering her face with her hands. She originally wanted to use this battle to set a certain level of difficulty for Aike, allowing her to grow and make breakthroughs while struggling on the edge of life and death, but she never expected that guys at the same level as her would be so stupid and vulnerable. "This... is really uncomfortable to watch." She frowned, her face full of disappointment and helplessness. "It's all because of those inexplicable earth skills! If she didn't have such useless skills, she could at least still fight to the death!" The Queen didn't know that Ai Ke didn't have any long-range attack skills at all. Most shadow beasts have some unique long-range skills that can cleverly use the enemy's shadow to launch unexpected attacks. This is also an important reason why shadow beasts are so powerful and fearsome on the ground with many shadows.
Aike opened the menu anxiously, checked carefully and decisively upgraded the [Scratch] skill. In an instant, it turned into a more powerful [Tear] skill, capable of causing a high amount of astonishing damage, but at the same time it also consumed a lot of physical strength and precious beast core energy.
Echo quietly moved behind the lizard and cautiously poked his head out again. At this time, her physical condition was pretty good, but because she was underground, she couldn't see the exact location of the lizard at all, which made her feel very troubled.
The lizard was lying down lazily at this time, seeming to be very bored and completely uninterested in this battle. And this time is just the right time for Aiko to attack its weakness...but where exactly should it be attacked? !
"When I used [Weakness Detection], it was all red." Aike frowned, his face full of distress and confusion. It seems that she has to pay more attention to improving the level of her skills, otherwise she has no chance of winning in this battle with great disparity in strength.
Determined, she burrowed underground and headed steadily toward the lizard's tail. She was fully focused and highly concentrated, and decisively used the [Tear] skill at the moment when the lizard was most relaxed and defenseless.
*tearing sound*
"Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh" the lizard let out a shrill, heart-rending scream. The sound echoed in the empty desert, as if it was about to break through the sky. Because someone actually cut the bottom of its tail deeply, and the excruciating pain made it almost go crazy.
When Aike saw the serious damage caused and the blood splattered everywhere, his eyes suddenly lit up and he giggled excitedly. The laughter was full of surprise and excitement. She never expected that such a simple skill upgrade could produce such a significant and astonishing effect... But at the same time, this attack did consume a lot of her physical strength. She knew in her heart that she had to manage her physical reserves more carefully and properly, otherwise she might lose her life if she was not careful.
She hid underground, not daring to come out, because the lizard kept making noises above her like crazy.
She waited quietly, not daring to make any rash move, because she knew clearly that if she could stay still, the physical energy consumed by the [Digging] skill would be greatly reduced.
"Where are you bastard?! Get out of here!" The lizard roared at the top of his lungs, his voice full of anger and madness. But no matter how it roared and searched, it couldn't find the mysterious attacker. This made it even more angry, and the animal nature in its heart was completely aroused, and it fell intoA state of madness.
Then, it suddenly noticed a small thing below, looming deep underground.
*roar*
It did not hesitate and immediately raised its body temperature to the extreme. The surrounding temperature rose sharply in an instant, as if it was in a furnace. The nearby sand and stones were instantly transformed into crystal clear glass under the terrifying high temperature. This fiery power penetrates deeply into the ground, as if it will burn all creatures hidden underground to ashes.
Ai Ke felt this blazing heat that could almost burn his soul, and he was suddenly frightened to death, and his liver and gallbladder were split. Without any hesitation, she immediately ran away deeper and further away from the lizard, using all her strength to avoid the impact of this heat wave that could destroy almost everything.
